$schema: Content recovery placement manifest. See CONTENT_RECOVERY_PLAN.md, 'Placement and reconstruction policy' and 'Required manifests and validation'. THIS FILE IS CURRENTLY A SKELETON: no authentic historic street_entities/MapFiller export has been recovered (RECOVERY_TODO.md: 'blocked'), and the synthetic seed (tools/seed-demo-world.mjs) does not yet place the newly converted 'chicken' or 'wood_tree' runtime assets -- it only places quoins plus the pre-existing DemoChicken/DemoTree/DemoWheat stand-ins. Populating 'placements' with demo- rows for the two converted assets is the next step (CONTENT_RECOVERY_PLAN.md implementation order step 4) and is intentionally left for follow-up so this manifest reflects only entities that are truly, currently reachable in-game.

provenanceKinds.meaning: Deterministic, geometry-aware but NOT historically accurate placement generated by a local script (e.g. tools/seed-demo-world.mjs). Must never be presented as original Children of Ur/Glitch placement data.
Imported from a validated, provenance-tracked authentic street_entities/MapFiller export. NONE exist yet -- see RECOVERY_TODO.md 'Authentic historic placements' (status: blocked).

rowSchema.id: string, primary key in street_entities; must start with the idPrefix for its provenanceKind
rowSchema.entityType: string, matches an entry in content/runtime-manifest.json's routeIds.entityClass (or the street_entities `type` column, e.g. Chicken, WoodTree, DemoChicken, Currant)
rowSchema.runtimeAssetId: string, foreign key into content/runtime-manifest.json assets[].id
rowSchema.sourceExport: string or null; for provenanceKind=recovered, the name/date of the validated export this row came from

coverageSummary.note: Full per-row placement data (35013 rows across 11 types) lives in the database, deterministically regenerable by rerunning tools/seed-demo-world.mjs -- it is not exhaustively duplicated here to avoid an unmaintainable multi-megabyte JSON file. 'placements' above holds 3 concrete example rows per newly-converted real-asset type (chicken/wood_tree/piggy/metalrock) for schema/provenance illustration; 'placementsByEntityType' below is the full aggregate.
